units.source_text: 葵夫人逝世，源氏遵制穿浅黑色丧服，曾有“丧衣色淡”之诗。

en.t: When Lady Aoi passed away, Genji observed the prescribed custom by wearing pale black mourning robes, and there was once a poem about the pale color of mourning clothes.

units.source_text: 此次紫夫人逝世，他穿的丧服黑色稍深。

en.t: This time, when Lady Murasaki passed away, the mourning robes he wore were a somewhat deeper black.

units.source_text: 世间尊荣富贵之人，往往为世人所痛嫉，或者倚财仗势，骄傲成性，使别人为他受苦。

en.t: People of high honor, wealth, and rank in the world are often bitterly envied by others, or else they rely on their wealth and power, become habitually arrogant, and make other people suffer for them.

units.source_text: 只有紫夫人为人异常谦恭，即使是和她全无关系之人，也都敬爱她。

en.t: Only Lady Murasaki was extraordinarily modest and courteous in character, so that even people with no connection to her at all respected and loved her.

units.source_text: 她的一举一动，无论何等些微，都受世人赞誉。

en.t: Every action of hers, no matter how slight, was praised by people everywhere.

units.source_text: 应付各种场面，都很诚恳周至。

en.t: In handling every kind of situation, she was always sincere and attentive in every detail.

units.source_text: 因此她死之后，对她并无深缘的一般人，听见风啸虫鸣，无不凄然下泪。

en.t: Therefore, after her death, even ordinary people who had no deep tie to her would hear the wind howl or insects cry and could not help shedding sorrowful tears.

units.source_text: 何况对她有一面之缘的人，更是悲伤得无以慰情了。

en.t: How much more, then, did those who had even once met her grieve beyond all comfort.

units.source_text: 多年来贴身伺候、亲睦驯熟的侍女，都悲叹自己苟延残喘，何其命苦。

en.t: The ladies in waiting who had served close beside her for many years and had grown intimate and familiar with her all lamented that they still lingered on, and how bitter their fate was.

units.source_text: 竟有痛下决心，削发为尼，遁世入山者。

en.t: Some even made the painful decision to cut off their hair, become nuns, renounce the world, and enter the mountains.

units.source_text: 冷泉院的秋好皇后也不断来信慰问，表示无限悲伤。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu of Reizei-in also kept sending letters of condolence, expressing boundless grief.
She once sent a poem that read:
